It is related to the [[Game Breaker]] item, which is obtained from a single bug report. == Obtaining == The '''Game Annihilator''' has only been obtained by four players for reporting 75+ game-breaking exploits in the span of a few months. == Gallery == Game Annihilator Screenshot 1.png|The Game Annihilator on display Game annihilator-4.png|The Game Annihilator as seen on four player's heads == Trivia == * On the internal Hypixel testing network, a '''Game Annihilator''' [[Fire Sale]] was once hosted. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2021/February 6|link=none|[[File:Game Annihilator.png|26px]] Added '''Game Annihilator'''.}} {{History|2023/July 4|link=none|Changed rarity from {{Special}} to {{Very Special}}.}} {{History|2023/Aug 22|'''Game Annihilator''' is now {{Soulbound|Co-op}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Special Items}} [[Category:Hypixel Gifts]]
